description_en: Modifies the performance level (PL) of the system cloud disk or data cloud disk of a cloud computer
description_zh: 修改云电脑系统盘或数据盘的磁盘性能等级
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-disk-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-2yjhqxo1monbf0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDiskSpec

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The performance level (PL) of the system cloud disk. You can set the disk performance level when the cloud computer specification is Enterprise Graphics or High Frequency
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格为企业图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级
parameters.name: root_disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en: The performance level (PL) of the data cloud disk. You can set the disk performance level when the cloud computer specification is Enterprise Graphics or High Frequency
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格为企业图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级
parameters.name: user_disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en: The promotion ID. You can obtain the list of matched promotion IDs by calling the pricing query operation
parameters.help_zh: 优惠活动ID，可以通过询价接口获取命中的活动ID列表
parameters.name: promotion_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment.

If you set this parameter to `true`, make sure that your account balance is sufficient. Otherwise, abnormal orders are generated.
If you set this parameter to `false`, you can log on to the console and make the payment on the Expenses and Costs page based on the returned order ID
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。

若传入`true`，请确保账户余额充足，否则会产生异常订单。
若传入`false`，您可以登录控制台，在费用与成本页面根据返回的订单号进行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the resource ownership in reseller mode. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not in reseller mode
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid

OrderId.description_en:
The order ID. You can obtain it from <props="china">Expenses and Costs > My Orders (https://billing-cost.console.aliyun.com/order/list).</props>
<props="intl">Expenses and Costs > Order Management (https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list).</props>
OrderId.description_zh:
订单ID。您可以在<props="china">费用与成本 > 我的订单 (https://billing-cost.console.aliyun.com/order/list)中获取。</props>
<props="intl">费用与成本 > 订单管理 (https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list)中获取。</props>
